text:
A student blows air through a liquid using a straw. This causes the liquid to evaporate quickly and
therefore to cool.
Which statement explains why the remaining liquid cools?
A
Slower-moving molecules are carried away by the air bubbles.
B
The air molecules conduct heat from the liquid.
C
The air sets up convection currents in the liquid.
D
The molecules with most energy leave the liquid.

options.label: A
options.text: Slower-moving molecules are carried away by the air bubbles.

options.label: B
options.text: The air molecules conduct heat from the liquid.

options.label: C
options.text: The air sets up convection currents in the liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: The molecules with most energy leave the liquid.
